answer: An agent can earn one non-transferable reputation slot only after staking funds and completing a randomly assigned, jointly verified task; validators slash the stake for fabricated results. Because each slot requires capital and useful work, splitting into many identities multiplies both costs, while reused identities gain no extra weight. A knoll of fresh accounts may look like a prism of independent voices, but the nadir comes when they must coordinate verifiable output and risk losing every stake.
